name: bld2_commuting_idempotents_rank_join
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : A * B = B * A) : Matrix.rank (A + B - A * B) + Matrix.rank (A * B) = Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank B
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K) (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hAB : A * B = B * A), Matrix.rank (A + B - A * B) + Matrix.rank (A * B) = Matrix.rank A + Matrix.rank B
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_idempotent_sum_rank twice: A and B - A*B are idempotents with idempotent sum A + B - A*B, so rank (A + B - A*B) = rank A + rank (B - A*B); A*B and B - A*B are idempotents with sum B, so rank B = rank (A*B) + rank (B - A*B).
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A B : Matrix ι ι K), A * A = A → B * B = B → A * B = B * A → (A + B - A * B).rank + (A * B).rank = A.rank + B.rank
